title: Reverse a String
description: Read a single line of text from input and print it reversed.
hint: A slice with a negative step walks a string backwards: text[::-1].
starter_code:
text = input()
# print the reversed text

title: Count the Vowels
description: Read a single line of text and print how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) it contains. Uppercase and lowercase letters count the same.
hint: Lowercase the text, then count the characters that appear in 'aeiou'.

io.output: A single integer: the vowel count.

starter_code:
text = input()
# print the number of vowels

title: Capitalise Each Word
description: Read a single line of text and print it with the first letter of every word in uppercase and the rest in lowercase. Words are separated by single spaces.
hint: Split on spaces, capitalise each word, then join them back together with a space.

io.input: A single line of words separated by spaces.
io.output: The line with each word capitalised.

starter_code:
text = input()
# print the text with each word capitalised
